response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), s AS (SELECT f.zoneref, f.articount, CAST(f.articount AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM scanfeatures f CROSS JOIN t WHERE f.articount IS NOT NULL AND t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each scanfeatures row with a non-null articount is one 'site artifact count'. Rows are not aggregated per zoneref, so a site can appear more than once.
The overall total is SUM(articount) over all scanfeatures rows. The average share is the mean of the per-row shares, with null counts excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Aggregate artifact counts per site (zoneref) first, then compute each site's share of the overall total, the mean share across sites, and the top 10 differences.
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS articount FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY zoneref HAVING SUM(articount) IS NOT NULL), t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), s AS (SELECT g.zoneref, g.articount, CAST(g.articount AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM g CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10
